errors.text_span: Червената линия, представляваща BG40 (дясна скала), започва около 100 през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The red line (BG40) does not start in 2001. It starts in 2005 at a value of approximately 200, not 100.
The peak of the red line (BG40) is at approximately 450, not 600, according to the right-hand scale.

errors.text_span: и след това остава в диапазона 200–400 до 2021 г., където се възстановява до около 350.
errors.evidence: The red line for BG40 does not continue to 2021; it stops around the year 2014. The description of its behavior until 2021 and its final value are hallucinated.

errors.text_span: Зелената линия, представляваща BGBX40 (дясна скала), започва около 100 през 2001 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) does not start in 2001. It starts around 2014 at a value of approximately 250, not 100.
The green line (BGBX40) does not exist before approximately 2014, so it cannot be described as remaining unchanged until 2013.

errors.text_span: след което започва бавно нарастване, достигайки около 250 към 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The green line (BGBX40) does not simply have a slow increase to 250. It starts near 250, fluctuates with a peak around 300 in 2018, and then returns to around 250 by 2021. Describing it as a slow increase to its final value is an inaccurate summary of its trend.

errors.text_span: достига връх от почти 2000 през 2008 г.
errors.evidence: The peak of the SOFIX (blue) line occurs in late 2007, not during 2008.
